title: X on the new records (eligibility, drafting, budget guard, withdraw); X stays off
description:
Rewire X announcement eligibility, drafting, budget guard and withdraw onto Announcement plus one Delivery (channel x, account). Delete the old row shape and the round suffix in the same change. No live X rows exist so nothing migrates; any dry-run rows are deleted, not converted. AnnouncementSpend, XConnection and AnnouncementSettings stay as built. The X floor (five stars on Machines on Machines) is a per-channel rule; the Announcement is created together with its first Delivery in one transaction; a later rating that reaches the floor adds the X Delivery to the same Announcement. Depends on slice 5a so X drafts are editable before the feed is ever turned on.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Channel rules (X needs the floor rating; a later rating adds the X Delivery to the existing Announcement; no bar below three stars; unrated and predicted never qualify; a machine never supplies the five).
- Gherkin: Dry run and withdraw (built and not sent, cost 0; withdraw deletes where possible and records who).
- Gherkin: The X model has no round suffix; old dry-run rows are gone.
- X remains OFF everywhere until the reshape and 5a are in and Ryan turns it on.
- Old Announcement row shape deleted in this change.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.

**Section 13 additions (2026-11-16, always-on agent review; changes A, L)**
- Now also blocked by the durable-triggers task (PPY-e3bb2b): X is driven from the change stream, not the best-effort publish call.
- A blocked draft asks for help once (change L): "Blocked: check failed" raises one review request (a flag; nothing waits) in the editor's inbox, grouped per Announcement, not per channel. The machine redrafts only when an input changes (the Story, the guidelines), never in a loop.
- Attempts follow the started/closed entries and sent-Delivery memory from PPY-a570e8 and PPY-9c6b89; approval is read from the Delivery.
**Acceptance criteria (added)**
- Gherkin: a draft that fails a check raises exactly one review request per Announcement and the machine does not redraft until the Story or guidelines change.

**Always-on agent standard (2026-11-16; design `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`)**
Names: the new decision model is `AnnouncementDecision`; this task deletes the old model `Announcement` (the X row shape) and its index. Use "Announcement" in the newsroom and documents. No rename of `AnnouncementDecision` follows. The X drafter and sender run as the announce agent under the standard: rung from the agent policy document (PPY-51ea61), every write through the gate (PPY-611397), spend on the one ledger (PPY-fa165c), pause as a tested kill switch (PPY-3f68f4).
